07/11.12.2024 Heard learned counsel for the appellant, learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for the informant.

2. The present appeal is filed against the order dated 09.08.2024, passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge-I-cum- Special Judge (POCSO) Act in Koderma (SC/ST) P.S. Case No. 12/2024, Spl.
POCSO Case No. 20/2024 registered under sections 376/420/34 of I.P.C., section 4 of POCSO Act and Section 3 (1) (r) and (s) of the Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities)
Act, 1989, pending in that Court.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that appellant and victim were in relationship since 2022 and case has been registered in the year, 2024.
He further submits that allegations are made of going to hotel along with informant and one hotelier has stated in para 19 of the case diary that both have not stayed in the hotel.
He further submits that the appellant is in custody since 17.06.2024.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer and submits that the case has been registered under section 376 I.P.C. as well as POCSO Act and SC/ST Act.

sentences.text:
5. Learned counsel for the informant opposes the prayer and submits that allegations are there and at the time of relationship the victim was aged about 17 years in that view of the matter case is made out.
6. Looking into contents of F.I.R., it appears that the appellant and victim were in relationship.

The relationship was established in the year, 2022 and F.I.R has been registered on 31.05.2024 and at present the victim is aged about 19 years even if age as pointed out by the learned counsel for the informant is accepted.
The appellant is in custody since 17.06.2024.
The Court has perused the case diary wherein para 19 it has been stated by one of the hotelier that both have not stayed in said hotel.
7. In view of above facts, I am inclined to grant regular bail to the appellant.

Accordingly, the above named appellant is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (twenty five thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Sessions Judge-I-cum-Special Judge (POCSO) Act in Koderma (SC/ST) P.S. Case No. 12/2024, Spl.
POCSO Case No. 20/2024, subject to conditions that the appellant shall not, directly or indirectly,
make any inducement, threat undue influence to the prosecution witnesses and the appellant shall appear before the trial court on each and every date given to them by the said Court till disposal of the trial.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-I-cum-Special Judge (POCSO) Act in Koderma (SC/ST) P.S. Case No. 12/2024
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 8. This appeal is allowed and disposed of and the impugned order dated 09.08.2024, passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge-I-cum-Special Judge (POCSO) Act in Koderma (SC/ST) P.S. Case No. 12/2024, Spl. POCSO Case No. 20/2024, is hereby set aside.

( Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J) Satyarthi Chunchun Pandey @ Shivam Pandey vs The State Of Jharkhand on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111730465/
